description: A limit on one action that the surface cannot lift, enforced by somebody other than the reader: a tenant policy, an administrator, the host application itself. A lock always names the action it pins and, when the enforcing party is known, WHO enforces it and WHY. The autonomy dial is not allowed to change a lock — it lists it next to the value so the reader knows why a grade is capped; a lock without a source would be an unexplained disabled control, and one without a reason is printed as the bare fact it is.

members.name: ActionLabel
members.description: The action the limit applies to, in the host's words ("Send external email", "Delete a file"). It is a LABEL, not an id: the surface prints it and never parses it.

members.name: HasReason
members.description: Whether the lock carries a reason worth printing.

members.name: HasSource
members.description: Whether the enforcing party is known.

members.name: Reason
members.description: Why the limit exists, in the host's own words. Null or empty renders no reason line.

members.name: Source
members.description: Who enforces the limit ("Tenant policy", "Compliance profile", "Workspace administrator"). Empty renders no "enforced by" line instead of a line with a blank source.

notes: A blank Source prints no "enforced by" line instead of a line with a blank source, and a null Reason prints no reason.
